main.summary: Readable stream wrapper that hashes every returned byte while forwarding read operations to an underlying source stream.

field.name: Source
field.summary: The underlying source stream that provides forwarded read operations.

field.name: Hash
field.summary: The incremental SHA-512 hash state fed by each forwarded read.

field.name: Finalized
field.summary: True once the current hash value has been finalized and retrieved.

field.name: LeaveOpen
field.summary: True when the underlying source stream should remain open when this wrapper is disposed.

field.name: disposed
field.summary: Tracks whether the stream has been disposed.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a hashing read wrapper over an existing source stream.
constructor.param: The source stream that provides forwarded reads.
True to leave the source stream open when the hashing wrapper is disposed; otherwise false.

method.name: GetHashAndReset
method.summary: Finalize and return the current SHA-512 digest for all bytes read so far.

property.name: CanRead
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the underlying source stream supports reading.

property.name: CanSeek
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the underlying source stream supports seeking.

property.name: CanWrite
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether this wrapper supports writing.

property.name: Length
property.summary: Gets the length of the underlying source stream.

property.name: Position
property.summary: Gets or sets the current position within the underlying source stream.

method.name: FlushAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously flush the underlying source stream.
method.returns: A task that completes when the underlying flush operation completes.

method.name: Read
method.summary: Read bytes from the underlying source stream and append them to the incremental SHA-512 state.
method.param: Destination buffer for the read bytes.
Start offset in the destination buffer.
Maximum number of bytes to read.
method.returns: The number of bytes read from the underlying source stream.

method.name: ReadSpan
method.summary: Read bytes into the supplied span and append the returned bytes to the incremental SHA-512 state.
method.param: Destination span for the read bytes.
method.returns: The number of bytes read from the underlying source stream.

method.name: ReadByte
method.summary: Read a single byte from the underlying source stream and append it to the incremental SHA-512 state.
method.returns: The read byte value, or -1 at end of stream.

method.name: ReadAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously read bytes from the underlying source stream and append them to the incremental SHA-512 state.
method.param: Destination buffer for the read bytes.
Start offset in the destination buffer.
Maximum number of bytes to read.
method.returns: A task that completes with the number of bytes read.

method.name: ReadAsyncMemory
method.summary: Asynchronously read bytes into the supplied memory and append the returned bytes to the incremental SHA-512 state.
method.param: Destination memory for the read bytes.
method.returns: A task-like value that completes with the number of bytes read.

method.name: Seek
method.summary: Change the position within the underlying source stream.
method.param: Reference point used to obtain the new position.
method.returns: The new position within the underlying source stream.

method.name: SetLength
method.summary: Set the length of the underlying source stream.
method.param: The desired length of the stream.

method.name: WriteAsync
method.returns: A task that faults because writing is not supported.

method.name: WriteAsyncMemory
method.returns: A task-like value that faults because writing is not supported.
